answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational energy to solve a cryptographic cipher. This process acts like a digital quartz clock, precisely measuring investment rather than identity. For an attacker, replicating this effort across false personas creates a karst of sunk costs that renders large-scale identity fabrication economically unviable, as the cost of hardware and electricity scales linearly with each fraudulent agent introduced.
